The 50 SMA at $16.26 is still well below the 200 SMA at $18.33. That's called a **death cross configuration** — the long-term trend is still bearish, and the short-term rally has simply brought price up to test the underside of a declining resistance line.

**The bull says "the 200 SMA doesn't turn up until price has been above it for weeks."** Exactly. And that means we don't know if this is a reversal or a **bear market rally** — the kind that has trapped countless buyers in downtrends. The stock was at $18.70 on May 17 and fell to $15.31 by May 31. That's a **18% decline in two weeks.** Now it's bounced back to $18.48.
